title: QD-Rec: Open-Ended Evolution of Recommendations via Quality-Diversity

paragraphs.en: Open-ended search combined with foundation models has produced advances such as faster algorithms, new results on open mathematical problems, and self-improving agents. We extend this paradigm to recommendation for decision-making, focusing on decisions where the set of possible choices is fixed but the reasons for choosing them are not. In high-stakes decisions, e.g., which company to acquire or which customer to target, comparing diverse, well-reasoned options can be more useful than a single ranked list. We formalize open-ended recommendation as building a diverse, high-quality set of recommendations, each an item together with a hypothesis , a natural-language reason why the item fits the needs of a decision maker. We propose QD-Rec, a quality–diversity method that selects items with a contextual bandit and generates hypotheses with a foundation model from earlier ones kept in an archive as stepping stones. A new recommendation enters the archive if it is novel or better than its nearest neighbor. Across M&A, customer targeting, and paper and book recommendation, QD-Rec gives the highest mean quality and builds the largest archive in most settings.
paragraphs.zh: 开放式搜索与基础模型相结合，催生了诸多进步，例如更高效的算法、开放数学问题的新解，以及能够自我改进的智能体。 我们将这一范式拓展至决策推荐领域，重点关注那些可选方案集合固定，但选择理由却非固定的决策场景。 在高风险决策中（例如选择收购哪家公司或锁定哪个客户），比较多样化且论证充分的选项，往往比单一的排序列表更具价值。 我们将开放式推荐形式化为构建一个多样化、高质量的推荐集：每个推荐项都包含一个物品以及一个假设——即一段自然语言解释，说明该物品为何符合决策者的需求。 我们提出了 QD-Rec 这一质量–多样性方法：它通过上下文多臂老虎机选择物品，并利用基础模型基于存档中的早期推荐项（作为阶梯）生成假设。 当一条新推荐具有创新性，或优于其最近的邻近推荐时，它将被纳入存档。 在并购、客户定位以及论文和书籍推荐等多个场景中，QD-Rec 在多数情况下都能实现最高的平均质量，并构建出最大的存档。

paragraphs.en: Open-ended search continually produces novel and increasingly capable or diverse discoveries, and each can serve as a stepping stone for further discovery ( Stanley and Lehman, 2015 ; Hughes et al., 2024 ) . Foundation models can act as the generator in this search, drawing on earlier candidates to write new ones. This approach has found candidates that no single query to the model would produce, including creative text ( Bradley et al., 2024 ) , adversarial prompts for red teaming ( Samvelyan et al., 2024 ) , tasks that reveal a model’s capabilities ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , loss functions ( Lu et al., 2024 ) , faster algorithms ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , new mathematical constructions ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) , agent designs ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , and self-improving agents ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 开放式搜索持续产生新颖且能力日益增强或多样化的发现，而每一项发现都可以成为进一步探索的垫脚石（Stanley 和 Lehman，2015；Hughes 等，2024）。 基础模型可以在此搜索中充当生成器，利用早期候选方案来生成新的方案。 这种方法发现了单个模型查询无法产生的候选方案，包括创意文本（Bradley 等，2024）、用于红队测试的对抗性提示（Samvelyan 等，2024）、揭示模型能力的任务（Lu 等，2025）、损失函数（Lu 等，2024）、更高效的算法（Novikov 等，2025）、新的数学构造（Romera-Paredes 等，2024；Novikov 等，2025）、智能体设计（Hu 等，2025）以及自我改进的智能体（Zhang 等，2026a；Wang 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026b）。

paragraphs.en: We ask whether open-ended search can extend to recommendation for decision-making. Unlike open-ended generation, where the model generates new candidates, many decisions are choices from a fixed pool of candidates: an acquirer chooses among the companies that exist, a reader among the papers already written, a marketer among the customers. At first glance, this leaves no room for open-endedness, since the pool is finite and known in advance. However, only the items are fixed. The same item can be chosen for many different reasons, so the search over reasons is still open-ended.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探讨开放式搜索是否可以扩展到决策推荐领域。 与开放式生成不同（在开放式生成中，模型会生成新的候选项），许多决策都是从固定的候选池中进行选择：收购方从现有的公司中选择，读者从已经写成的论文中选择，营销人员则从客户群体中选择。 乍一看，这似乎没有留下任何开放性的空间，因为候选池是有限的且事先已知。 然而，只有候选项本身是固定的。 同一项内容可能因多种不同原因被选择，因此对原因的搜索仍然是开放式的。

sents.zh: 我们探讨开放式搜索是否可以扩展到决策推荐领域。

paragraphs.en: We therefore treat recommendation for such decisions as an open-ended search over item–hypothesis pairs. A hypothesis is a natural-language explanation of why an item fits the decision maker’s profile, such as the profile of one acquirer or one reader. The search returns a diverse, high-quality set of such pairs for a single profile, rather than one ranked list of items. We call this problem open-ended recommendation . In high-stakes decisions, people need to compare candidate items together with the reasons for choosing them ( Aggarwal, 2016 ) . We evaluate the set by its quality and diversity, following the quality–diversity (QD) view of illuminating a space of alternatives ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们将此类决策中的推荐视为对商品–假设组合的开放式搜索。 假设是一种自然语言解释，说明某项商品为何符合决策者的特征，例如某个购买者或读者的特征。 对于单个特征，该搜索会返回一组多样化且高质量的商品–假设组合，而非仅返回一个排序后的商品列表。 我们将此问题称为开放式推荐。 在高风险决策中，人们需要同时比较候选商品及其选择理由（Aggarwal, 2016）。 我们依据质量和多样性来评估该集合，遵循通过质量–多样性（QD）视角来揭示替代方案空间的理念（Mouret and Clune, 2015）。

paragraphs.en: Open-ended recommendation has two properties that make open-ended search a good fit. First, evaluation is costly: we learn a recommendation’s value only by writing its hypothesis and judging it, so we cannot simply score every possible recommendation in advance and sort them. The system must therefore decide which item to evaluate next and learn from each result. Second, the space is larger than the pool: each item allows unlimited hypotheses, so even evaluating every item once would leave most of the space unexplored. Good hypotheses often come from adapting or combining earlier ones, so keeping modest intermediate hypotheses as stepping stones can help ( Lehman and Stanley, 2011 ; Stanley and Lehman, 2015 ) . QD and novelty search were designed for such problems ( Risi et al., 2025 ) , but to our knowledge they have not been applied to recommendation. 1 1 1 Evolutionary methods have been applied to decision-making more broadly, for example to evolve neural networks that prescribe interventions against COVID-19 ( Risi et al., 2025 , Section 6.4) .
paragraphs.zh: 开放式推荐具有两个特性，使得开放式搜索成为合适的选择。 首先，评估成本高昂：我们只能通过撰写假设并对其进行判断来了解推荐的價值，因此无法提前为所有可能的推荐打分并排序。 因此，系统必须决定接下来要评估哪一项内容，并从每个结果中学习。 其次，搜索空间比候选池更大：每一项内容都允许无限多的假设，因此即使对每一项内容仅评估一次，大部分搜索空间仍无法被探索。 优秀的假设通常源于对早期假设的改编或组合，因此保留适度的中间假设作为阶梯可能会有所帮助（Lehman and Stanley, 2011；Stanley and Lehman, 2015）。 QD 和新颖性搜索正是为这类问题而设计的（Risi et al., 2025），但据我们所知，它们尚未被应用于推荐领域。1 1 1 进化方法已被更广泛地应用于决策领域，例如用于演化能够制定针对 COVID-19 干预措施的神经网络（Risi et al., 2025，第 6.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: We introduce QD-Rec , a quality–diversity search method for open-ended recommendation (Figure 1 ). In QD-Rec, an LLM called the proposer writes hypotheses, and an LLM judge or humans score them. Each iteration has three steps. A contextual bandit selects an item from the candidate pool, balancing items that look promising against regions the archive has not yet covered. The proposer generates a hypothesis for that item, building on a few earlier hypotheses from the archive. The new recommendation is kept if it is novel, or if it is better than its nearest neighbor in the archive. Novelty and quality are thus judged locally , by comparison with nearby recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 QD-Rec，一种用于开放式推荐的质量-多样性搜索方法（图 1）。 在 QD-Rec 中，一个名为“提议者”的 LLM 负责撰写假设，而另一个 LLM 裁判或人类则对其进行评分。 每次迭代包含三个步骤。 一个上下文多臂老虎机从候选池中选择一个项目，在看似有前景的项目与存档尚未覆盖的区域之间进行权衡。 “提议者”会针对该项目生成一个假设，并基于存档中少数早期的假设进行构建。 如果新推荐具有新颖性，或者优于存档中与其最近的邻居，则保留该推荐。 因此，新颖性和质量是通过与附近的推荐进行比较来进行局部判断的。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are: (i) we formalize open-ended recommendation as a quality–diversity search over item–hypothesis pairs, where the items come from a fixed pool; (ii) we propose QD-Rec, with two ablations isolating its components (Table 1 ); and (iii) across four domains and two proposers, QD-Rec gives the highest mean quality in most LLM-judged settings, usually builds the largest archive, and outperforms diversity-aware rerankers on human-rated quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献包括：(i) 我们将开放式推荐形式化为对物品–假设对的质量–多样性搜索，其中物品来自一个固定的集合；(ii) 我们提出了 QD-Rec，并通过两种消融研究对其各组件进行了验证（表 1）；以及 (iii) 在四个领域和两种提议者中，QD-Rec 在大多数由 LLM 评估的设置中获得了最高的平均质量，通常能构建最大的档案库，并且在人类评估的质量方面优于注重多样性的重排序器。

paragraphs.en: We briefly review quality–diversity methods and novelty search, evolutionary loops built around foundation models, and recommender systems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们简要回顾了质量-多样性方法和新颖性搜索、围绕基础模型构建的进化循环，以及推荐系统。

paragraphs.en: Quality–diversity (QD) methods aim to discover a set of high-performing yet diverse solutions rather than a single optimum. Multi-dimensional Archive of Phenotypic (MAP) Elites “illuminates” a search space by maintaining an archive and retaining elites across behavioral niches ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ) . Novelty search emphasizes exploration by rewarding behavioral novelty, providing a mechanism for stepping-stone trajectories in which intermediate solutions enable later progress ( Lehman and Stanley, 2011 ) . Recent work continues to revisit local competition and novelty definitions in QD, including dominated novelty variants ( Bahlous-Boldi et al., 2025 ) , and extensions that reduce dependence on hand-designed behavioral descriptors, such as dimensionless MAP-Elites ( Dharna et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 质量-多样性（QD）方法旨在发现一组性能优异且多样化的解决方案，而非仅仅寻找单一最优解。 表型多维精英档案（MAP）方法通过维护一个档案库并保留不同行为生态位中的精英个体，从而“照亮”整个搜索空间（Mouret and Clune, 2015）。 新颖性搜索通过奖励行为上的新颖性来强调探索过程，为阶梯式演进路径提供了一种机制，其中中间解决方案能够促进后续进展（Lehman and Stanley, 2011）。 近期的研究持续重新审视QD方法中局部竞争与新颖性的定义，包括受支配的新颖性变体（Bahlous-Boldi et al., 2025），以及减少对人工设计行为描述符依赖的扩展方法，例如无量纲MAP-精英算法（Dharna et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Quality–diversity (QD) methods aim to discover a set of high-performing yet diverse solutions rather than a single optimum.
sents.zh: 质量-多样性（QD）方法旨在发现一组性能优异且多样化的解决方案，而非仅仅寻找单一最优解。

sents.en: Multi-dimensional Archive of Phenotypic (MAP) Elites “illuminates” a search space by maintaining an archive and retaining elites across behavioral niches ( Mouret and Clune, 2015 ) .
sents.zh: 表型多维精英档案（MAP）方法通过维护一个档案库并保留不同行为生态位中的精英个体，从而“照亮”整个搜索空间（Mouret and Clune, 2015）。

sents.en: Novelty search emphasizes exploration by rewarding behavioral novelty, providing a mechanism for stepping-stone trajectories in which intermediate solutions enable later progress ( Lehman and Stanley, 2011 ) .
sents.zh: 新颖性搜索通过奖励行为上的新颖性来强调探索过程，为阶梯式演进路径提供了一种机制，其中中间解决方案能够促进后续进展（Lehman and Stanley, 2011）。

sents.en: Recent work continues to revisit local competition and novelty definitions in QD, including dominated novelty variants ( Bahlous-Boldi et al., 2025 ) , and extensions that reduce dependence on hand-designed behavioral descriptors, such as dimensionless MAP-Elites ( Dharna et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: A growing family of systems places a frozen large model inside an evolutionary or QD loop as a proposal operator or mutator, keeping an archive of artifacts that the model conditions on to propose the next: diverse creative text in QDAIF ( Bradley et al., 2024 ) , adversarial prompts in Rainbow Teaming ( Samvelyan et al., 2024 ) , code and program search in ELM ( Lehman et al., 2023 ) and FunSearch ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ) , algorithm discovery in AlphaEvolve ( Novikov et al., 2025 ) , sample-efficient program evolution in ShinkaEvolve ( Lange et al., 2026 ) , open-ended evaluation tasks in Automated Capability Discovery ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , and agent designs in ADAS ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . 2 2 2 In evolutionary loops, foundation models can also play roles other than proposing new artifacts. In CycleQD ( Kuroki et al., 2025 ) and AC/DC ( Dai et al., 2026 ) , they are themselves the artifacts being evolved. In a replication of Picbreeder ( Earle et al., 2026 ) , vision–language models take the place of its human evaluators. A separate line of work is self-referential : STOP ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) , the Darwin Gödel Machine ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , the Huxley–Gödel Machine ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and Hyperagents ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) turn the search on the machinery itself, so the improved scaffold or agent performs the next round of improvement. QD-Rec belongs to the first group, with item–hypothesis pairs as the artifacts. However, these systems create new artifacts, while QD-Rec must choose its items from a fixed pool.

paragraphs.en: Recommenders learn either offline , from a fixed dataset of past interactions ( Aggarwal, 2016 ) , or online , as a sequential decision problem with an exploration–exploitation trade-off, usually modeled as a (contextual) bandit ( Lattimore and Szepesvári, 2020 ; Agarwal et al., 2009 ; Li et al., 2010 ; Agrawal and Goyal, 2013 ; Song et al., 2022 ) . The evolutionary loops above are sequential as well, but they generate their candidates rather than choose them from a pool. QD-Rec does both, generating hypotheses for items selected from a fixed pool, so it selects items with a contextual bandit; unlike a recommender’s bandit, however, it is judged, as in QD, by its final archive. Orthogonally, a long line of work treats diversity, novelty, coverage, and serendipity as first-class objectives ( McNee et al., 2006 ; Ziegler et al., 2005 ; Vargas and Castells, 2011 ; Kaminskas and Bridge, 2016 ) , pursued offline by re-ranking ( Carbonell and Goldstein, 1998 ; Chen et al., 2018 ) and online by diversity-aware bandits ( Radlinski et al., 2008 ; Liu et al., 2020 ) . These methods diversify the list shown to a user; QD-Rec instead enforces diversity at archive admission, following recent QD systems ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Dharna et al., 2025 ) : an LLM judges whether each new pair is novel relative to its nearest archive neighbors. Finally, explainable recommendation adds a natural-language explanation to each recommended item ( Zhang and Chen, 2020 ) , and so do LLM recommenders that reason before choosing or justify afterward. QD-Rec also pairs each item with a reason, but it does so inside an evolutionary loop.
paragraphs.zh: 推荐系统要么离线学习，从历史交互的固定数据集中学习（Aggarwal, 2016），要么在线学习，将其视为一个存在探索与利用权衡的序列决策问题，通常建模为（情境）多臂老虎机问题（Lattimore and Szepesvári, 2020；Agarwal et al., 2009；Li et al., 2010；Agrawal and Goyal, 2013；Song et al., 2022）。 上述演化循环同样是序列性的，但它们会生成候选项，而不是从候选池中挑选。 QD-Rec 同时执行这两种操作：它基于固定候选池生成物品假设，因此通过情境多臂老虎机选择物品；但与推荐系统的多臂老虎机不同，QD-Rec 的性能如同 QD 一样，由其最终存档进行评估。 在另一个独立方向上，大量研究将多样性、新颖性、覆盖性和意外发现视为首要目标（McNee et al., 2006；Ziegler et al., 2005；Vargas and Castells, 2011；Kaminskas and Bridge, 2016），这些目标通过离线重排序（Carbonell and Goldstein, 1998；Chen et al., 2018）和在线多样性感知多臂老虎机（Radlinski et al., 2008；Liu et al., 2020）来实现。 这些方法旨在多样化展示给用户的列表；而 QD-Rec 则在存档接纳阶段强制实现多样性，遵循近期的 QD 系统（Lu et al., 2025；Dharna et al., 2025）：一个 LLM 会判断每对新组合相对于其在存档中的最近邻是否具有新颖性。 最后，可解释的推荐会为每个推荐物品添加自然语言解释（Zhang and Chen, 2020），同样地，LLM 推荐系统也会在做出选择前进行推理或事后提供理由。 QD-Rec 也会为每个物品附加一个理由，但这一过程发生在演化循环内部。

paragraphs.en: We present QD-Rec , an archive-based quality–diversity (QD) method for open-ended recommendation. QD-Rec keeps an archive 𝒜 \mathcal{A} of retained recommendations and returns it as 𝒮 \mathcal{S} at the end of the run. Each new entry is compared only with its nearest neighbors in the archive to decide whether it is kept. Each archive entry x x stores a recommendation ( c , h ) (c,h) , its embedding e = Embed ⁡ ( c , h ) e=\mathrm{Embed}(c,h) , and its quality score q ⁡ ( x ) q(x) . The embedding is computed from a structured item profile followed by the hypothesis text. We use cosine similarity sim ⁡ ( x i , x j ) = ⟨ e i , e j ⟩ / ( ‖ e i ‖ ​ ‖ e j ‖ ) \mathrm{sim}(x_{i},x_{j})=\langle e_{i},e_{j}\rangle/(\|e_{i}\|\,\|e_{j}\|) to define these neighborhoods.

paragraphs.en: Given the selected item c c , we prompt the proposer LLM with the profile π \pi , the item c c , and m m exemplars sampled uniformly from the current archive. The prompt presents the exemplars as existing hypotheses and instructs the model to apply one of three operators, mutate (adapt one exemplar’s angle to c c ), crossover (combine angles from several exemplars), or explore (propose an angle the exemplars miss), so the archive acts as an evolving population ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Lehman et al., 2023 ) .

paragraphs.en: We also define two simpler variants of QD-Rec, which serve as ablations of the full method. Novelty+Evo replaces the bandit with uniform-random item selection. Algorithm 1 gives QD-Rec in full.

paragraphs.en: To speed up experiments, we run the loop in parallel batches where workers propose and evaluate candidates against a snapshot of the current archive. To select a batch of B B items, we extend the single-draw rule of Section 4.2 : we take B B independent posterior draws θ ~ 1 , … , θ ~ B \tilde{\theta}_{1},\dots,\tilde{\theta}_{B} , and for each θ ~ i \tilde{\theta}_{i} select the candidate maximizing s ⁡ ( c ) s(c) while excluding items already chosen in the batch and adding them to ℛ \mathcal{R} , so the diversity bonus discourages near-duplicates within a batch as well as against the archive. After each batch, we reconcile results by filtering near-duplicate additions (above a cosine-similarity threshold) and resolving replacement collisions (multiple workers targeting the same neighbor). The bandit uses prior precision λ = 1 \lambda=1 and noise standard deviation σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1 , the novelty check uses k = 3 k=3 nearest neighbors, and each run starts from 10 10 seed entries.
paragraphs.zh: 为加快实验速度，我们以并行批次的形式运行该循环，其中工作智能体基于当前存档的快照来提出并评估候选项。 为选择一批 B 个物品，我们扩展了第 4.2 节中的单次抽取规则：我们进行 B 次独立的后验抽取 θ ~ 1 , … , θ ~ B \tilde{\theta}_{1},\dots,\tilde{\theta}_{B}，并对每个 θ ~ i \tilde{\theta}_{i} 选择使 s ⁡ ( c ) s(c) 最大化的候选项，同时排除该批次中已选中的物品，并将其加入 ℛ \mathcal{R}；这样，多样性奖励既能抑制批次内的近似重复项，也能防止与存档中的项目重复。 每个批次结束后，我们通过过滤近似重复的添加项（余弦相似度超过设定阈值的情况），并解决替换冲突（多个工作智能体同时选择同一邻域项），来协调各批次的结果。 该多臂老虎机使用先验精度 λ = 1 \lambda=1 和噪声标准差 σ = 0.1 \sigma=0.1，新颖性检查使用 k = 3 k=3 个最近邻，且每次运行均从 10 个种子条目开始。

paragraphs.en: Our main experiment uses claude-sonnet-5 as the hypothesis proposer; we additionally report a weaker-proposer ablation that swaps in claude-haiku-4-5 . The judge is gpt-5.6-terra in every configuration and domain, a different model family from both proposers, to prevent self-preference bias ( Wataoka et al., 2024 ) . Proposer and judge both run with reasoning effort set to high . The weak-proposer ablation model does not support the effort parameter and runs without it or extended thinking. We leave the temperature setting to the provider default for claude-haiku-4-5 . Each configuration runs 1,000 1{,}000 evaluations (proposal–judge cycles) per method in all four domains, executed in generations of up to 20 20 parallel evaluations, with the archive reconciled between generations (Section 4.3 ). Novelty+Evo and QD-Rec condition each proposal on m = 3 m=3 archive exemplars. Runs are repeated for five random seeds. Each run begins from a seed archive under the same profile π \pi ; the seed controls the pipeline’s own sampling randomness (parent selection, item ordering) while LLM sampling stays at the provider default, so across-seed spread measures the stochasticity of the full pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要实验使用 claude-sonnet-5 作为假设提出者；此外，我们还报告了一个使用 claude-haiku-4-5 替换提出的较弱提出者消融实验。 在所有配置和领域中，评判者均为 gpt-5.6-terra，这是一个与两位提出者均属于不同模型家族的模型，以避免自我偏好偏差（Wataoka 等人，2024）。 提出者和评判者均以高推理努力模式运行。 较弱提出者的消融模型不支持努力参数，因此在不使用该参数或扩展思考的情况下运行。 对于 claude-haiku-4-5，我们将温度设置保留为提供商的默认值。 在所有四个领域中，每种配置对每种方法运行 1,000 次评估（提出–评判循环），评估以每代最多 20 次并行评估的方式进行，且各代之间会对存档进行协调（第 4.3 节）。 Novelty+Evo 和 QD-Rec 将每次提出都基于 m = 3 个存档样本进行条件约束。 实验针对五个随机种子重复运行。 每次运行均从同一配置文件 π 下的初始存档开始；该种子控制流程本身的采样随机性（父本选择、项目排序），而 LLM 的采样则保持为提供商的默认值，因此跨种子的差异反映了整个流程的随机性。

paragraphs.en: Goodreads. The pool 𝒞 \mathcal{C} is the children’s books a reader has rated ( Wan and McAuley, 2018 ) ; the profile π \pi is that reader (summarized from past reviews); h h is a reading memo on whether they would enjoy a book. Uniquely, quality is not an LLM judge but the reader’s own 1 1 – 5 5 rating, held out of all prompts and used only as the reward and replacement signal (Appendix C ), testing whether QD still yields meaningful quality–diversity tradeoffs under a real human signal. This Quality measure evaluates the book for the reader, not the generated memo: changing the memo cannot change the rating, although it can affect novelty and archive geometry.
paragraphs.zh: Goodreads。 池 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 是指读者已评分的儿童读物（Wan 和 McAuley，2018）；个人资料 π \pi 代表该读者（根据过往评论总结得出）；h h 是一份关于其是否会喜欢某本书的阅读备忘录。 独特之处在于，质量并非由 LLM 判断，而是由读者自己的 1–5 分评分决定。这一评分在所有提示中均保留，且仅用作奖励和替换信号（附录 C），用于测试 QD 在真实人类信号下是否仍能产生有意义的质量-多样性权衡。 这种质量衡量标准评估的是书籍对读者的价值，而非生成的备忘录：更改备忘录不会改变评分，但可能会影响新颖性和存档几何结构。

paragraphs.en: We measure cost as the API spend of a run in US dollars at list prices. It covers every model call: the proposer, the quality judge, the novelty check, the duel, and the embeddings. The three variants make the same calls for each of the 1,000 1{,}000 evaluations. They differ only in the proposer prompt, which includes three archive exemplars in Novelty+Evo and QD-Rec, and in how often a duel is needed. The bandit runs locally and adds no API cost. The runs did not log token usage, so we estimate the cost of each call type by re-sending a sample of 840 840 archived calls with the same models and settings. We then multiply by the exact number of calls in each run. QD-Rec costs the same as Novelty+Evo, and both cost about 1.3 × 1.3\times as much as Novelty. More than 90 % 90\% of the difference comes from the proposer, because the exemplars roughly triple its input. A single run costs between about $13 (Novelty on Goodreads with the claude-haiku-4-5 proposer) and $62 (QD-Rec on Marketing with the claude-sonnet-5 proposer). Goodreads is the cheapest domain because its ratings replace the LLM judge and the duel.

paragraphs.en: To ask whether the online learning and archive machinery earns its cost, we compare against two training-free re-rankers, relevance-MMR ( Carbonell and Goldstein, 1998 ) and a quality-weighted DPP with greedy MAP inference ( Chen et al., 2018 ) , on Goodreads, where Quality is a real human star rating. Sweeping each baseline’s relevance–diversity weight γ \gamma ,no setting of either reaches any QD variant on Quality, and they approach QD-Rec’s semantic Diversity only at their most diversity-favoring settings. The baselines see no ratings while the QD variants query up to 1,000 1{,}000 , so the gap reflects rating feedback and the archive together, not item selection alone. Full setup and the per-setting table are in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究在线学习和存档机制是否物有所值，我们在 Goodreads 平台上将其与两种无需训练的重新排序器进行比较：relevance-MMR（Carbonell 和 Goldstein，1998）以及采用贪心 MAP 推理的质量加权 DPP（Chen 等，2018），其中“质量”是真实用户给出的星级评分。 通过遍历每种基线模型的相关性-多样性权重 γ \gamma，我们发现没有任何一种设置能在“质量”指标上达到任何 QD 变体的水平；只有在最偏向多样性的设置下，它们才接近 QD-Rec 的语义多样性。 基线模型未获得任何评分，而 QD 变体最多会查询 1,000 个结果，因此这一差距反映了评分反馈与存档机制的共同作用，而非仅由物品选择决定。 完整的实验设置以及各设置对应的表格见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: We introduced QD-Rec, an archive-based quality–diversity method for open-ended recommendation, where the items are chosen with contextual bandits, and the reasons for recommending them are searched open-endedly. Across four domains, QD-Rec gave the best mean Quality in most settings and usually built the largest archive. As a first work along this line, we kept it relatively simple, and several directions follow.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 QD-Rec，这是一种基于档案库的质量-多样性方法，适用于开放式推荐任务。其中，项目通过上下文多臂老虎机进行选择，而推荐这些项目的原因则通过开放式搜索确定。 在四个不同领域测试中，QD-Rec 在大多数设置下都获得了最高的平均质量，并且通常构建出最大的档案库。 作为这一研究方向的初步工作，我们将其设计得相对简单，后续还有多个可能的拓展方向。

paragraphs.en: First, our bandit uses Bayesian linear regression to model reward from fixed item embeddings. Neural contextual bandits ( Zhou et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2021 ) could capture nonlinear relationships between these embeddings and reward. More radically, the bandit could be discarded altogether in favor of a coding agent that reads the archive directly, reasons over which regions look exhausted and which look promising, and writes its own selection rule, replacing a fixed parametric reward model with a policy that can be inspected and revised in natural language. Second, exemplars are sampled uniformly from the archive, and could instead be selected by quality, recency, or how often they have already served as exemplars ( Earle et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Third, this work focused on the outer loop : which item to evaluate next, and which pairs to retain. The inner hypothesis generator was a single prompted LLM call, and could instead be a full research agent ( Shang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) ; we kept it lightweight to show that the outer loop is itself a meaningful lever, and expect the two to compose.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们的多臂老虎机使用贝叶斯线性回归来对固定物品嵌入表示所对应的奖励进行建模。 神经上下文多臂老虎机（Zhou 等，2020；Zhang 等，2021）能够捕捉这些嵌入表示与奖励之间的非线性关系。 更进一步地，我们可以完全摒弃多臂老虎机，转而采用一种编码智能体：它直接读取档案库，分析哪些区域已耗尽、哪些仍有潜力，并自行编写选择规则，从而用一种可用自然语言进行审查和修订的策略取代固定的参数化奖励模型。 其次，当前示例是从档案库中均匀采样的，但也可以根据质量、时效性或它们作为示例被使用的频率来选择（Earle 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026a）。 第三，本研究聚焦于外层循环：即接下来应评估哪件物品，以及应保留哪些物品对。 内层的假设生成器仅是一次带有提示的 LLM 调用，但也可以替换为一个完整的研究智能体（Shang 等，2025；Lin 等，2026）；我们将其设计得尽可能轻量，以表明外层循环本身就是一个有意义的调节手段，并预期两者能够协同工作。

paragraphs.en: Unlike Quality, Diversity changes little after the first ∼ 100 {\sim}100 evaluations, while archive size n n keeps growing. A likely reason is that admission is decided by the LLM novelty check against nearest neighbors, not by an embedding-distance threshold. New entries then add distinct hypotheses within the region the archive already spans, which raises n n but not the mean pairwise distance.
paragraphs.zh: 与“质量”不同，“多样性”在最初的 ∼ 100 {\sim}100 次评估后变化很小，而存档大小 n n 却在持续增加。 一个可能的原因是，是否接纳新条目由 LLM 对最近邻的新颖性检查决定，而非由嵌入距离的阈值决定。 因此，新条目会在存档已覆盖的区域内部增加独特的假设，这会提升 n n，但不会增加平均成对距离。

paragraphs.en: Neither baseline uses an archive, novelty filter, or feedback, and no LLM touches anything that could affect the headline result: selection is pure geometry over precomputed content embeddings, with relevance cos ⁡ ( item , π ) \cos(\text{item},\pi) rather than an LLM score (scoring the full pool with an LLM is precisely the cost our setting excludes), and Quality is the human star rating, fixed the moment an item is selected. paragraphs.en: For each reader, the Coverage grid is fitted jointly to all QD, MMR, and DPP rows using full SVD and the same 1% padding convention. This larger reference pool differs from Table 2 , so absolute Coverage need not match across tables. The comparison is not a controlled ablation of item selection, however: the QD variants observe the rating of every item they evaluate (up to 1,000 1{,}000 per run) and use it for replacement and, in QD-Rec, for the bandit, whereas the baselines see none. They are no-feedback geometric references, and the gap measures what rating feedback and the archive machinery buy together. Every run is matched in archive size n n to the QD-Rec archive of its reader; selection is deterministic given the embeddings, so rows are single runs (Table 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个读者，覆盖网格通过完整的奇异值分解（SVD）和相同的 1% 填充约定，与所有 QD、MMR 和 DPP 行联合拟合。 这个更大的参考池与表 2 不同，因此各表中的绝对覆盖值不必一致。 然而，这种比较并非对物品选择的受控消融：QD 变体能够观察到它们评估的每个物品的评分（每次运行最多 1,000 个），并用于替换以及在 QD-Rec 中用于多臂老虎机问题，而基线模型则无法看到任何评分。 它们是零反馈的几何参考，而该差距衡量了评分反馈与存档机制共同带来的提升。 每次运行在存档大小 n 上与对应读者的 QD-Rec 存档相匹配；在嵌入向量给定的情况下，选择是确定性的，因此每行代表单次运行（表 4）。

paragraphs.en: We use the Children subset of the UCSD Goodreads Book Graph ( Wan and McAuley, 2018 ) . For each reader, the candidate pool is their own rated books (minus the few used to construct the profile), so every item carries a ground-truth rating. We select two readers by a fixed procedure, set before any experiment. A reader qualifies if they meet six thresholds: at least 200 200 rated books, at least 500 500 written reviews, a rating standard deviation of at least 0.9 0.9 , at least 70 % 70\% of shelved books marked as read, at least 80 % 80\% of sampled reviews in English, and an entropy of at least 2.0 2.0 nats in their books’ distribution over shelves. Of the 542,145 542{,}145 readers, 8 8 qualify. We take the qualifying reader with the most ratings, and then the one with the most ratings whose most common shelf differs from the first reader’s. This gives a picture-book reader ( 1,761 1{,}761 books) and a series/young-adult reader ( 1,117 1{,}117 books). Goodreads uses the reader’s 1 1 – 5 5 rating in place of the LLM judge, so the bandit reward is q ⁡ ( x ) / 5 q(x)/5 . In the local comparison, a new book replaces its nearest neighbor only if its rating is strictly higher; ties keep the incumbent. Books are selected without replacement in all three variants, including seed books and discarded proposals, because a fixed rating means a new memo for the same book would get the same score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 UCSD Goodreads 图书图谱（Wan 和 McAuley，2018）中的 Children 子集。对于每位读者，候选池由他们自己评分的图书组成（减去用于构建个人资料的少数图书），因此每个项目都带有真实评分。我们通过一套在任何实验之前预先设定的固定流程来选择两位读者。若满足以下六个阈值，则视为合格：至少 200 本已评分的图书、至少 500 篇已撰写的书评、评分标准差至少为 0.9、已标记为“已读”的书架图书比例至少为 70%、抽样书评中英语书评的比例至少为 80%，以及其图书在书架上的分布熵值至少为 2.0 nats。在 542,145 位读者中，有 8 位符合资格。我们首先选择评分最多的合格读者，然后选择第二位读者——其最常见的书架与第一位读者的不同，且该读者也拥有最多的评分。由此，我们得到一位图画书读者（1,761 本图书）和一位系列/青少年文学读者（1,117 本图书）。Goodreads 使用读者的 1–5 分制评分来替代 LLM 评判员，因此 bandit 奖励为 q(x)/5。在局部比较中，只有当新书的评分严格高于其最近邻时，才会用新书替换后者；若评分相同，则保留现有图书。在所有三种变体中，图书均按无放回方式选择，包括种子图书和已淘汰的提案，因为固定评分意味着同一本书的新备忘录将获得相同的分数。

paragraphs.en: We construct country-specific company universes from LSEG Workspace data that combine (i) tabular financial snapshot features (as of 2024-08-31) and (ii) textual business descriptions. We filter to a target country, retain feature columns with at least 0.80 fill rate, and merge description fields into a single company profile. This yields universes of 6,332 USA companies. The profile π \pi is an acquirer selected from the same universe; in our runs we use two USA acquirers, Walt Disney Co and JPMorgan Chase & Co. For QD-Rec, each candidate company has a precomputed embedding of its business description, used only for bandit item selection. The proposer, the judge and the archive embedding use the full company profile, which also includes the location, the industry classification and the financial features.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 LSEG Workspace 数据中构建特定国家的公司宇宙，该宇宙结合了 (i) 截至 2024-08-31 的表格化财务快照特征和 (ii) 文本形式的业务描述。 我们筛选出目标国家，保留填充率至少为 0.80 的特征列，并将描述字段合并为一个统一的公司档案。 由此得到了包含 6,332 家美国公司的公司宇宙。 档案 π \pi 是一个从同一宇宙中选择的收购方；在我们的运行中，我们使用了两家美国收购方：华特迪士尼公司和摩根大通公司。 对于 QD-Rec，每个候选公司都有一个预先计算好的业务描述嵌入向量，该向量仅用于 bandit 项目选择。 提议者、评判者和存档嵌入均使用完整的公司档案，其中还包括公司所在地、行业分类和财务特征。

paragraphs.en: We use a subset of the NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-USA dataset, a large-scale synthetic customer-profile corpus aligned to real-world US demographic distributions ( Meyer and Corneil, 2025 ) . We use this synthetic dataset as a proxy in lieu of sensitive real-world customer data. Each customer profile includes demographic attributes (e.g., age, sex, marital status, education, occupation, city/state) and multiple profile facets (professional, sports, arts, travel, culinary). To control for regional heterogeneity we restrict to a single state (California) and sample 10,000 customer profiles for experiments. We use two distinct product profiles (a desktop 3D printer and an online upskilling subscription), spanning different purchase contexts (a one-time tool purchase vs. career reskilling). The seed archive is initialized from sampled customer profiles, and the three variants iteratively generate and evaluate targeting hypotheses for additional profiles.

paragraphs.en: We use a fixed collection of paper metadata (title and abstract only) drawn from three recent machine-learning conferences: ICLR 2026, ICML 2026, and NeurIPS 2025. We filter to accepted statuses (Oral, Spotlight, and Poster, plus ICLR’s conditional accepts) and retain entries with non-empty identifier, title, and abstract, yielding 17,511 papers (5,358 / 6,341 / 5,812 for ICLR / ICML / NeurIPS respectively). The metadata is obtained from the papercopilot/paperlists repository ( Paper Copilot (2026), Jing Yang ) . We precompute candidate embeddings from title+abstract for bandit item selection. Archive embeddings are computed from the concatenated title, abstract, and memo ( item_hypothesis mode) and are used for novelty-neighbor retrieval, semantic Diversity, and Coverage. The three variants generate memos for selected papers and apply the same local novelty-first archive update procedure.

paragraphs.en: Goodreads has no LLM quality judge (Quality is the reader’s held-out star rating), so its prompt set is smaller: memo generation and the novelty check. paragraphs.en: Novelty wrote its hypothesis for Liberty TripAdvisor without earlier examples. It argued that JPMorgan’s existing Chase Travel platform and commercial partnerships made an acquisition unnecessary, so it offered no affirmative reason to buy the company (1/10). QD-Rec drew on an archived hypothesis proposing that JPMorgan acquire Southwest Airlines. The parent proposed integrating financing, payments and rewards into travel purchases, and using transaction data to improve credit decisions and offer related financial products. The judge recognized this commercial rationale but scored the parent 1/10, citing restrictions on bank ownership of an airline and exposure to fuel, labor and other operating risks.
paragraphs.zh: Novelty 在没有先例的情况下，为 Liberty TripAdvisor 提出了其假设。 它认为，JPMorgan 现有的 Chase Travel 平台和商业合作使得收购并无必要，因此没有给出任何支持收购该公司的明确理由（1/10）。 QD-Rec 借鉴了一个存档的假设，该假设建议 JPMorgan 收购 Southwest Airlines。 母公司提议将融资、支付和奖励整合到旅行购买中，并利用交易数据来改进信用决策以及提供相关的金融产品。 法官认可了这一商业逻辑，但鉴于银行对航空公司所有权受到限制，且面临燃料、劳工及其他运营风险，因此给母公司打了 1/10 的分数。

paragraphs.en: The mutate operator adapted this rationale to the travel marketplaces described in Liberty TripAdvisor’s company information. The child proposed connecting bookings for activities, dining and accommodation to Chase Travel, rewards redemption and installment financing. It retained the parent’s idea of linking travel purchases to financial services, while changing the target from an airline to a travel platform. The judge rated the child 5/10, although it still raised concerns about competition, acquisition complexity and whether partnerships would suffice. A parent rated only 1/10 thus served as a stepping stone for a more highly rated recommendation about a different company.
paragraphs.zh: mutate 操作符将这一逻辑应用于 Liberty TripAdvisor 公司信息中描述的旅行市场。 该子方案提议将活动、餐饮和住宿的预订与 Chase Travel、奖励兑换及分期付款服务相连接。 它保留了父方案中将旅行消费与金融服务关联起来的思路，但将目标从航空公司改为旅行平台。 法官对该子方案的评价为 5/10，尽管该方案仍引发了对竞争、收购复杂性以及合作伙伴关系是否足够的担忧。 一个仅得 1/10 分的父方案因此成为提出另一家公司的更高评分建议的垫脚石。

paragraphs.en: In this example, the model generated statements and interpretations absent from the input, including a loyalty base of more than 100 million members. For example, Southwest’s July 22, 2026 announcement came after the model’s knowledge cutoff and reported “nearly 100 million Members.” We could not verify the claim of more than 100 million members. The financial snapshot is dated August 2024, but note that Tripadvisor acquired Liberty TripAdvisor Holdings in April 2025 . In this experiment, we supplied the model with only basic financial data and short business descriptions. Using the recommendations for actual decisions would require more detailed and up-to-date information.

paragraphs.en: Novelty focused on the nurse’s clinical career goals and SkillForge’s lack of accredited nursing courses. It recognized that project management and data analysis could help with his planned screening program, but treated these as peripheral needs and his shift work as an obstacle to study. It concluded that the platform was a poor fit (2/10). QD-Rec drew on an archived hypothesis about a preschool teacher seeking district-wide curriculum leadership. The parent argued that SkillForge could supply project management, data analysis and presentation skills needed for this transition but not fully covered by her teaching training (7/10).
paragraphs.zh: 新颖之处在于该护士的临床职业目标，以及 SkillForge 缺乏经认证的护理课程。 它认识到项目管理和数据分析有助于他计划的筛查项目，但将这些视为次要需求，并将他的轮班工作视为学习的障碍。 它得出结论，认为该平台并不适合（2/10）。 QD-Rec 参考了一个存档假设，该假设涉及一位寻求在全区担任课程领导职务的学前教师。 这位家长认为，SkillForge 可以提供这种职业转型所需的项目管理、数据分析和演示技能，但这些技能并非她的教师培训所完全涵盖的（7/10）。

paragraphs.en: The mutate operator applied this reasoning to the nurse’s ambition to lead a team and launch a community screening program. The child connected project management to coordinating screenings, data analysis to reporting health outcomes, and presentation skills to securing support from hospital administrators or funders. These skills became the main reason to recommend SkillForge as a complement to his clinical education. The child also argued that the platform’s flexible format could suit his irregular schedule. The judge found the connection between his leadership goals and the courses credible and rated the child 7/10. Reusing the teacher’s hypothesis helped QD-Rec connect the nurse’s leadership goals to courses that Novelty had dismissed as peripheral.
paragraphs.zh: mutate 操作符将这一推理应用于护士希望领导团队并启动社区筛查项目的抱负。 这名儿童将项目管理与协调筛查工作联系起来，将数据分析与报告健康成果联系起来，并将演示技能与从医院管理者或资助者那里获得支持联系起来。 这些技能成为推荐 SkillForge 作为其临床教育补充方案的主要原因。 这名儿童还认为，该平台灵活的形式能够适应他不规律的日程安排。 法官认为他的领导目标与课程之间的联系具有可信度，并给这名儿童的评分为 7/10。 复用教师的假设帮助 QD-Rec 将护士的领导目标与 Novelty 曾视为边缘性的课程联系起来。
